Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N and Q followed by N numbers. Now Q inputs of 2 Numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. So for each U,V find the XOR of all values of the array from the index U to V (1 based indexing). HINT : USE SEGMENT TREE
